## Downloads

- **Windows x64 (Intel / AMD)**: [{{WINDOWS_X64_ZIP}}]({{WINDOWS_X64_URL}})
- **Windows ARM64 (e.g. Snapdragon)**: [{{WINDOWS_ARM64_ZIP}}]({{WINDOWS_ARM64_URL}})
- **macOS Universal (Intel / Apple Silicon)**: [{{MACOS_UNIVERSAL_ZIP}}]({{MACOS_UNIVERSAL_URL}})

## Installation and requirements

- Windows 10+: choose the package matching your processor, extract all files, and run `light_novel_image.exe`. Install the matching Visual C++ Redistributable if needed.
- macOS 12+: use the same universal package on either processor. Extract and move the `.app` to Applications. The app is not Developer ID signed or notarized; you may need to allow opening it in Privacy & Security settings.

## Updates

- Smoother large-book browsing and batch imports with lower memory usage.
- Read beyond the image context and return to the image's original position.
- Fixed floating-button flicker and improved arrow-key navigation.
- Added native Windows ARM64 packages and a single universal macOS package.

Full history: [Changelog](https://github.com/{{REPOSITORY}}/blob/v{{VERSION}}/CHANGELOG.md).
